Complement gives k2/DOWN with unit formation weights, proportions (path,matching)=(4/5,1/5). Both the fine and stationary-Markovized continuations have W=0.
assumptions: Finite irreducible chain with positive stationary law and surjective coarse map
Fibre-compatible stopping set and coarse readout; both killed kernels transient
Pair-update and direction-specific support hypotheses only for CL-T94/CL-T95 as stated
scope: Finite positive stationary support, surjective coarse representation, fibre-compatible stopping/route/target maps, and transient original and reset killed chains. All-m statements require their stated update/direction hypotheses; finite counts refer only to frozen N4 H2 one-role grades 1/4 and 4, pair-event clock.

proof_or_verification.proof_sketch: Killed UP states have five or six edges. Exiting five edges deletes one of five equiprobable present edges, with four pendant outcomes and one C4. A constant column solves both killed equations; uniqueness follows from almost-sure return. Complement proves the other direction.

counterexample_scope: A task-specific zero is not full path equality, global HMM minimality, physical memory or cross-programme operator identity.
notes: Symbolic proof plus synthetic/neutral rational fixtures and separately frozen finite application; model agreement is not proof.

title: Comparator adequacy is task and projection scoped
statement: Comparator adequacy is task- and projection-dependent: matching occupancy and stationary adjacency need not match stopping, while a task-specific null need not imply process equality.
